LESSON: HADITH ON: RESPONSIBILITY

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.4: Hadith on: responsibility

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Hadith on: responsibility. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify responsible ways of taking care of the facilities in school.
2. Appreciate the teachings of the selected Hadith in nurturing a responsible person Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Learning to learn Critical thinking and problem solving 156 Citizenship-group work

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify responsible ways of taking care of the facilities in school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify responsible ways of taking care of the facilities in school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate the teachings of the selected Hadith in nurturing a responsible person Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Learning to learn Critical thinking and problem solving 156 Citizenship-group work
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the teachings of the selected Hadith in nurturing a responsible person Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Learning to learn Critical thinking and problem solving 156 Citizenship-group work. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Hadith on: responsibility.
2. Explain Hadith on: responsibility to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on: responsibility.
4. Show that you can: Identify responsible ways of taking care of the facilities in school.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on: responsibility. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Hadith on: responsibility important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Identify responsible ways of taking care of the facilities in school.
2. Appreciate the teachings of the selected Hadith in nurturing a responsible person Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Learning to learn Critical thinking and problem solving 156 Citizenship-group work

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
